items_flat.title_en: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20% for three months
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API 與積分價格調降逾20%，為期三個月
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it is dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next three months. The reduction applies to the API and eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex credit plans; Pro, Plus and Business subscription usage limits remain unchanged. Standard short-context rates move to $4/$20 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布未來三個月將 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與積分價格調降逾20%。降價適用於 API 及符合資格的 ChatGPT Work、Codex 積分方案；Pro、Plus 與 Business 訂閱使用額度不變。標準短上下文價格調整為每百萬 token 輸入4美元、輸出20美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The temporary cut lowers the cost of frontier agent and coding workloads on the flagship model without altering subscription caps, potentially accelerating high-volume iteration while testing competitive pressure from Anthropic and others.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這次臨時降價在不更動訂閱上限的前提下，降低旗艦模型在代理與編程工作負載的成本，可能加速大量迭代，同時測試來自 Anthropic 等競爭對手的價格壓力。
items_flat.quote: As we continue to push the frontier of capabilities while improving efficiency, we're dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next 3 months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在持續推動能力前沿並提升效率的同時，我們將 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 API 與積分價格調降逾20%，為期三個月。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands Claude Mythos 5 defensive access via Claude Security and partners
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 透過 Claude Security 與合作夥伴擴大 Claude Mythos 5 防禦存取
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Mythos 5 is now available in Claude Security for Enterprise customers to scan codebases and suggest patches, is being integrated into partners’ cyber tools, and launched a $35 million Defender Advantage Fund for open-source security work.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Mythos 5 現已於 Claude Security 提供給企業客戶掃描程式碼庫並建議修補，同時整合至合作夥伴資安工具，並成立3500萬美元 Defender Advantage Fund 支援開源資安工作。
items_flat.analysis_en: By routing Mythos 5 through constrained product interfaces rather than direct model access, Anthropic aims to scale defensive cyber capability while containing dual-use risk. Real-world patch uptake and partner integration depth remain the key unknowns.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過受限產品介面而非直接模型存取來部署 Mythos 5，Anthropic 試圖在擴大防禦能力的同時控制雙用途風險。實際修補採用率與合作夥伴整合深度仍是關鍵未知數。
items_flat.quote: Claude Mythos 5 is now available in Claude Security, and coming soon to partners' cyber defense tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Mythos 5 現已於 Claude Security 可用，並即將整合至合作夥伴的網路防禦工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing compatible with Zero Data Retention
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽可與 Zero Data Retention 相容的 Private Safety Processing
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a preview of Private Safety Processing for Zero Data Retention (ZDR) customers on frontier models. The system aims to detect patterns of misuse across multiple interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布為 Zero Data Retention（ZDR）客戶在前沿模型上預覽 Private Safety Processing。該系統旨在跨多輪互動偵測濫用模式，同時不讓 OpenAI 人員接觸底層內容。
items_flat.analysis_en: This attempts to reconcile enterprise privacy demands with the need for multi-turn safety monitoring as agents grow more capable. Real-world effectiveness and customer uptake will determine whether ZDR remains viable at the frontier.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉試圖在企業隱私需求與代理能力提升後所需的多輪安全監控之間取得平衡。實際效果與客戶採用情況將決定 ZDR 在前沿模型上是否仍可行。
items_flat.quote: Private Safety Processing is designed to identify patterns across related interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.quote_zh: Private Safety Processing 的設計目標是跨相關互動識別模式，同時不讓 OpenAI 人員接觸底層內容。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot expanded to SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+ and Teams plans
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot 擴展至 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 與 Teams 方案
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok Bot is now included with SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, Cursor Ultra and all Cursor Teams plans, plus a limited free trial for other users. Bots run on their own cloud computers and can execute multi-step jobs across tools.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok Bot 現已包含於 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+、Cursor Ultra 及所有 Cursor Teams 方案，並為其他使用者提供有限免費試用。Bot 在獨立雲端電腦上運行，可跨工具執行多步驟任務。
items_flat.analysis_en: Wider plan inclusion lowers the barrier to persistent agent teammates and tightens the product feedback loop for xAI’s agent roadmap, though enterprise waitlisting signals controlled rollout.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的方案納入降低了使用持久代理隊友的門檻，並強化 xAI 代理路線圖的產品回饋循環，但企業仍需等待名單顯示其採可控推出策略。
items_flat.quote: We're making Grok Bot more widely available. All SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and Cursor Teams subscribers now have access.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們讓 Grok Bot 更廣泛可用。所有 SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+ 與 Cursor Teams 訂閱者現已可使用。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 現已於 Google Enterprise Agent Platform 可用
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.6 is available via Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform / Model Garden. The model offers a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, priced at $2 / $6 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已可透過 Google Enterprise Agent Platform／Model Garden 使用。該模型提供50萬上下文視窗與可配置推理等級，價格為每百萬 token 輸入2美元、輸出6美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Adding Google’s enterprise platform alongside existing Bedrock availability expands multi-cloud options for agent workloads and intensifies competition among frontier models on major cloud marketplaces.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在既有 Bedrock 可用性之外再加入 Google 企業平台，擴大了代理工作負載的多雲選項，並加劇前沿模型在主要雲端市場的競爭。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 is now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6現已於Google Enterprise Agent Platform提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches AI Futures strategic blog on concentration-of-power risks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 AI Futures 戰略部落格，聚焦權力集中風險
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published the inaugural post of its new Strategic Futures team blog, AI Futures. The piece, by Dean Ball, frames concentration of power as the largest long-run risk from transformative AI and outlines principles for preserving individual agency.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布新成立 Strategic Futures 團隊部落格 AI Futures 的首篇文章。作者 Dean Ball 將權力集中定位為轉型 AI 長期最大風險，並提出維護個人自主性的原則。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is OpenAI’s most explicit public framing yet of structural political-economy risks beyond technical safety. It signals a shift toward longer-horizon institutional thinking, though the team’s internal influence remains untested.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 OpenAI 至今最明確公開討論技術安全之外的結構性政經風險。它顯示轉向更長期制度思考的訊號，但該團隊的內部影響力仍待檢驗。
items_flat.quote: It is our pleasure to launch AI Futures, the blog of OpenAI’s new Strategic Futures team.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們很高興推出 AI Futures，這是 OpenAI 新成立 Strategic Futures 團隊的部落格。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 31 European markets
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT 廣告擴展至31個歐洲市場
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT Ads to 31 European countries next week, including Germany, France, Spain and Italy. Ads remain limited to Free and Go users; paid plans stay ad-free.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將於下週把 ChatGPT 廣告擴展至31個歐洲國家，包括德國、法國、西班牙與義大利。廣告僅限 Free 與 Go 使用者；付費方案仍維持無廣告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move accelerates monetization of the free tier while testing European regulatory and user acceptance. It also broadens the geographic base for advertiser demand data.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉加速免費層級的變現，同時測試歐洲監管與使用者接受度，並擴大廣告主需求數據的地理基礎。
items_flat.quote: Next week, ChatGPT Ads will expand to 31 European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Austria.
items_flat.quote_zh: 下週，ChatGPT廣告將擴展至31個歐洲國家，包括德國、法國、西班牙、義大利、瑞典、挪威、丹麥、荷蘭與奧地利。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 現已於 Amazon Bedrock 正式可用
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model supports a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, priced at $2 / $6 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已於 Amazon Bedrock 正式可用。該模型支援50萬上下文視窗與可配置推理等級，價格為每百萬 token 輸入2美元、輸出6美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bedrock availability lowers the barrier for AWS-centric enterprises to trial Grok 4.6 alongside other frontier models, intensifying multi-cloud competition for agent workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock 可用性降低了以 AWS 為中心的企業試用 Grok 4.6 的門檻，並加劇代理工作負載的多雲競爭。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們很高興宣布Grok 4.6已在Amazon Bedrock正式上線。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Build expands to web and mobile on every plan
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Build 擴展至所有方案的網頁與行動版
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI made Grok Build available on web and mobile for every plan. The coding agent previously required desktop or specific access paths.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok Build 在所有方案的網頁與行動版皆可使用。此編程代理先前需透過桌面或特定路徑存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader surface availability increases everyday usage of Grok’s agent tooling and tightens the feedback loop for iterative improvements that Elon Musk has publicly emphasized.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的介面可用性提升日常使用 Grok 代理工具的頻率，並強化 Elon Musk 公開強調的迭代改進回饋循環。
items_flat.quote: Grok Build is now available on every plan, on the web and on mobile.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build現已在所有方案的網頁與行動版上線。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk highlights near-daily Grok Build improvements
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 強調 Grok Build 近乎每日改進
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day, linking to the product page after a detailed community changelog on subagent speed, workflow UX and multitasking.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文表示 Grok Build 的改進幾乎每日持續，並在社群詳細變更日誌後連結產品頁，內容涵蓋子代理速度、工作流程 UX 與多工處理。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cadence underscores xAI’s focus on agent reliability over pure benchmark leaps. Sustained daily polish may matter more for real productivity than occasional large model drops.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此節奏凸顯 xAI 重視代理可靠性甚於純基準飛躍。持續每日打磨對實際生產力的影響，可能大於偶爾的大型模型發布。
items_flat.quote: Improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build 的改進幾乎每日持續。

xai.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok Build 在所有方案的網頁與行動版皆可使用。此編程代理先前需透過桌面或特定路徑存取。
xai.analysis_en: Broader surface availability increases everyday usage of Grok’s agent tooling and tightens the feedback loop for iterative improvements that Elon Musk has publicly emphasized.
xai.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的介面可用性提升日常使用 Grok 代理工具的頻率，並強化 Elon Musk 公開強調的迭代改進回饋循環。
xai.quote: Grok Build is now available on every plan, on the web and on mobile.
xai.quote_zh: Grok Build現已在所有方案的網頁與行動版上線。

xai.title_en: Elon Musk highlights near-daily Grok Build improvements
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk 強調 Grok Build 近乎每日改進
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day, linking to the product page after a detailed community changelog on subagent speed, workflow UX and multitasking.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文表示 Grok Build 的改進幾乎每日持續，並在社群詳細變更日誌後連結產品頁，內容涵蓋子代理速度、工作流程 UX 與多工處理。
xai.analysis_en: The cadence underscores xAI’s focus on agent reliability over pure benchmark leaps. Sustained daily polish may matter more for real productivity than occasional large model drops.
xai.analysis_zh: 此節奏凸顯 xAI 重視代理可靠性甚於純基準飛躍。持續每日打磨對實際生產力的影響，可能大於偶爾的大型模型發布。
xai.quote: Improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day.
xai.quote_zh: Grok Build 的改進幾乎每日持續。

brief_en: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol API/credit prices >20% for three months and continues ZDR safety work. Anthropic expanded Mythos 5 defensive access via Claude Security plus a $35M fund. xAI widened Grok Bot to more plans and highlighted Grok 4.6 multi-cloud availability plus daily Build polish.
brief_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 Sol API／積分價格調降逾20%三個月，並持續推ZDR安全機制。Anthropic 透過 Claude Security 擴大 Mythos 5 防禦存取並設3500萬美元基金。xAI 擴展 Grok Bot 至更多方案，強調 Grok 4.6 多雲可用與 Build 每日改進。
